ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (29) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Страдания» (stradaniya, 'sufferings') keeps the Russian plural where Tolstoy uses it, and «благо» (blago, 'the good') is 'a good' in the closing thought and in Buka, where the website draft had 'a blessing'; «совершенствование» (sovershenstvovanie) is 'perfecting'. In Lamennais «отец» (otets, 'father') stays lowercase as in the source, and attributions follow the print (Thoreau, Jean Paul (Richter), Anatole France).
